headline_marked: Chrome's 'Select from Screen' [[lets you ask Gemini about anything on your screen]]
headline: Chrome's 'Select from Screen' lets you ask Gemini about anything on your screen
summary: New Chrome feature allows users to select and ask Gemini about specific parts of a webpage
details: The 'Select from Screen' tool is available in Chrome version 149, allowing users to highlight specific areas of a webpage and ask Gemini questions about them. This feature works similarly to Circle to Search on mobile devices.
To use the feature, users can open Chrome, click the 'Ask Gemini' button, and then select 'Select from screen'. They can then adjust the selected area and type in their questions.
The feature can be used for various scenarios, such as comparing products, getting explanations for diagrams or text, and reimagining or redesigning ideas.
caption:
